eval (() => {   const table = document.querySelector('table.wikitable');   if (!table) return 'No table';   const headerRow = table.querySelector('tr');   return Array.from(headerRow.cells).map(c => c.textContent.trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ')); })()

eval (() => {   const table = document.querySelector('table.wikitable');   if (!table) return 'No table';   const headers = Array.from(table.querySelectorAll('th'));   return headers.map(h => h.textContent.trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ')); })()

eval (() => {   const table = document.querySelector('table.wikitable');   const rows = Array.from(table.querySelectorAll('tr'));   const headers = Array.from(rows[1].cells).map(c => c.textContent.trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' '));   const tungstenRow = rows.find(r => r.textContent.includes('Tungsten'));   const cells = Array.from(tungstenRow.cells).map(c => c.textContent.trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' '));   return headers.map((h, i) => h + ': ' + cells[i]); })()
